nodes.notes: Final output contract for this sub-workflow: a single top-level 'storyboard_json' object, consumed by the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node. FIXED: now also preserves workflow_run_id (was missing).

meta.notes: Sprint 1-3 scaffold sub-workflow. Input contract: workflow_run_id + script_json. The HTTP Request node calls a FastAPI route ('/api/agents/storyboard') that does not exist yet — the current backend only has /approvals, /feature-flags, /lineage, and /health*. No AI/shot-breakdown logic lives in this workflow itself. Output contract: a single top-level 'storyboard_json' object, intended to be called via Execute Workflow from 'Arya OS - Main Orchestrator'.
